positions.as_written: Expect tendon to bone healing at the soft tissue end.
Read the clinical evidence as shorter and smaller than for the other autografts.
Treat this graft as the answer to a diameter problem and as the graft whose long term evidence is still accumulating.
Use it where diameter cannot be achieved from the hamstrings.
Counsel that its long term comparative evidence is still accumulating.
Expect harvest quality to depend on familiarity more than for a simpler harvest.
Measure tendon thickness on imaging before planning the harvest.
Consider it first in revision where other donor sites are used.
Expect small numbers in the revision evidence for this graft.
